'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Rafah aid distribution incidents]]
****At least 31 [[Palestinians]] are killed and 170 others are injured while thousands of people went to receive aid from an [[United States|American]]-funded [[humanitarian aid]] distribution centre in [[Gaza City]], [[Gaza Strip]]. Israel strongly denies its responsibility and releases drone footage showing armed, masked men firing at civilians attempting to collect humanitarian aid. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-hostages-aid-06-01-2025-67688833abb96fc068c42d10da90a0a4 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c991j01lym3o (BBC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Operation Spider's Web]]
***[[Ukraine]] says at least 40 [[Russian Air Force|Russian warplanes]], including several [[strategic bomber]]s were destroyed or damaged by [[Drone warfare|drone attacks]] on four air bases in [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cgrg7kelk45t (BBC News)]
**Russia launches the largest drone attack on Ukraine since the start of the war, comprising 472 drones and seven [[ballistic missile]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-sumy-region-18966d4b286ffb6f4e764b94a6afaf61 (AP)]
**Twelve [[Ukrainian Armed Forces|Ukrainian servicemembers]] are killed and 60 more are injured in a Russian missile strike on a training camp in [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]]. The commander of the [[Ground Forces of Ukraine]], [[Mykhailo Drapatyi]], submits a resignation request following the incident. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/news/2025/06/1/7515066/ (''Ukrainian Pravda'')] [https://www.rbc.ua/rus/news/udar-rf-navchalnomu-pidrozdilu-suhoputnih-1748777742.html (RBC-Ukraine)]
*[[Terrorism in Russia]]
**[[2025 Russia bridge collapses]]
***A support on a bridge explodes and collapses in [[Kursk Oblast]], [[Russia]], causing a [[freight train]] to derail, killing a worker and injuring two others, including the driver. The incident is being probed as an act of [[terrorism]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cr7zjy89304o (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/bridge-collapses-russias-bryansk-region-that-borders-ukraine-governor-says-2025-05-31/ (Reuters)] [https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-train-bryansk-klimov-derailment/33430473.html (RFE-RL)]
*[[Violent incidents in reaction to the Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Boulder fire attack]]
***Seven people are injured, including the perpetrator and one critically, in a [[firebombing]] attack when a man attacks protestors demanding the release of [[Gaza war hostage crisis|Israeli captives who remain in Gaza]] at the [[Pearl Street Mall]] in [[Boulder, Colorado|Boulder]], [[Colorado]], [[United States]]. [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] director [[Kash Patel]] claims it was a "targeted terror attack". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/1/several-people-wounded-in-attack-in-us-city-of-boulder-coloradol (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cjdx44kx5zxt (BBC News)]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] militants seize a [[Malian Armed Forces]] base near [[Burkina Faso–Mali border|the border]] with [[Burkina Faso]], killing more than 30 Malian troops, while also launching an attack on [[Timbuktu Airport]] where [[Wagner Group]] forces are stationed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/insurgents-overrun-mali-base-killing-dozens-soldiers-sources-say-2025-06-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twelve people are killed and several others are injured in a fire at a [[Drug rehabilitation|drug rehabilitation center]] in [[San José Iturbide]], [[Guanajuato]], [[Mexico]]. The cause is still under investigation. [https://www.barrons.com/news/12-dead-in-fire-at-mexican-drug-rehabilitation-center-prosecutors-8a812949?refsec=topics_afp-news (''Barron's'')] [https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2025/06/01/confirman-12-muertos-tras-incendio-en-centro-de-rehabilitacion-de-san-jose-iturbide-guanajuato/ (Infobae)]
*Seven people are killed after an aluminium boat with fifteen occupants capsized, presumably due to a gust of wind and a large wave on the Maroni river near [[Albina, Suriname]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2569877 (NOS)] 
*Five people are killed in a fire at an apartment block in [[Riggae]], [[Kuwait]]. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/948031/five-dead-in-kuwait-apartment-block-fire-official/story/ (GMA News)]
*Three soldiers are killed in a landslide at an army camp in Chaten, [[Sikkim]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-floods-army-landslide-sikkim-northeast-gangtok-c27bd9cc1c9bad2ba65b56ef2c059f5f (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 UEFA Champions League final]], [[2024–25 UEFA Champions League]]
**[[2025 Paris Saint-Germain celebration riots]]
***[[Fireworks]] and [[flare]]s are fired in [[Paris]], [[France]], after [[Paris Saint-Germain FC]]'s [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League title]] win. Two people are killed, a [[Paris Police Prefecture|police officer]] is in a [[coma]], 201 others are injured, four stores are [[looting|looted]] and hundreds are arrested in clashes with [[riot police]] for violence and looting. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/2-fans-died-and-an-officer-is-in-a-coma-after-champions-league-celebrations-in-france/ (CTV News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckgqyg325gno (BBC News)] [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/sports/article/2025/06/01/paris-erupts-with-flares-and-fireworks-the-eiffel-tower-lit-up-in-blue-and-red-after-psg-s-champions-league-title_6741878_9.html (''Le Monde'')]
*[[Non-cooperation movement (2024)|Non-cooperation movement]]
**A court in [[Bangladesh]] indicts former [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|prime minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]] and former [[Minister of Home Affairs (Bangladesh)|home affairs minister]] [[Asaduzzaman Khan]] on [[mass murder]] charges in relation to the deaths of protesters that ousted Hasina in 2024. The [[government of Bangladesh]] informs [[India]] of the [[arrest warrant]] and asks for Hasina's repatriation, following her escape to India. [https://www.financialexpress.com/world-news/ousted-bangladesh-pm-sheikh-hasina-faces-trial-for-mass-murder-could-get-death-penalty-if-convicted/3864635/ (''Financial Express'')]
*Three people are killed and 34 others are injured in a suspected [[arson]] attack at a hospital in [[Hamburg]], [[Germany]]. A suspect is arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-hamburg-hospital-fire-patients-killed-2e7cef97031023382e7fd9e6bedc1aac (AP)]
*A ban on the sale of [[Electronic cigarette|disposable vapes]] enters force in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c80kxx2xr77o (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Polish presidential election]]
**[[Polish people|Poles]] vote in the second round to choose their [[President of Poland|president]]. [[Right-wing populist]]  [[Institute of National Remembrance|President of the Institute of National Remembrance]] [[Karol Nawrocki]] wins 50.89% of popular vote over [[pro-European]] incumbent [[Mayor of Warsaw]] [[Rafał Trzaskowski]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jun/01/poland-goes-to-the-polls-in-second-round-of-close-fought-presidential-election (''The Guardian'')] [https://tvn24.pl/polska/wybory-prezydenckie-2025-kto-wygral-dane-pkw-ze-100-procent-obwodow-glosowania-st8491422 (TVN24)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/2/karol-nawrocki-wins-polands-presidential-election-media-reports-say (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 Mexican judicial elections]]
**Nationwide elections are held to elect over 2,700 members of the [[Mexico|Mexican]] [[Judiciary of Mexico|judiciary branch]] in the first ever [[judiciary|judicial]] election in the country's history. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-votes-first-judicial-election-amid-concerns-over-rule-law-2025-06-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 South Korean presidential election]]
**[[Independent (politician)|Independent]] [[President of South Korea|presidential]] candidate [[Hwang Kyo-ahn]] resigns from his candidacy for the upcoming presidential election and declares his support for [[People Power Party (South Korea)|People Power Party]] candidate [[Kim Moon-soo (politician)|Kim Moon-soo]]. [https://www.chosun.com/english/national-en/2025/06/01/TW2LTDSEHNDYBC46QQVPMS4YWI/ (''The Chosun Ilbo'')]
